_comment: Debt deals in the FactSet snapshot (tools/hyperscalers/raw/factset/<date>-debt.json) that no 424B filing-fee exhibit matched (144A notes, converts placed via 6-K/8-K, loans): the SEC filing that documents each deal. filing = an EDGAR full-text search (efts.sec.gov) over the issuer's 8-K / 424B / FWP / 6-K filings within −12/+25 days of the FactSet issue date returned the tranche's coupon-and-maturity phrase or facility type in that filing (accession, filed date, documents, phrases); the index confirms the phrase, the document text was not read in this session. textSrc = a passage of a 10-K/10-Q/20-F already harvested (raw/notes/) that names the instrument, with page and quote (checked against the harvested page by build.mjs). result: filing | partial (filing describes a related facility or the date differs) | unresolved (no filing found or FactSet's record does not match the filings read; reason given). Amounts stay FactSet's. Written 2026-10-03 (owner's third review). reviewedBy stays null until a person signs off.

method.en: EDGAR full-text search (efts.sec.gov/LATEST/search-index) by CIK, form and date window for the phrase "<coupon>% notes due <year>", "convertible senior notes due <year>", "term loan", "credit agreement" or "revolving credit"; hits list the filing's accession and the documents that contain the phrase.
method.es: Búsqueda de texto completo en EDGAR (efts.sec.gov/LATEST/search-index) por CIK, forma y ventana de fechas de la frase «<cupón>% notes due <año>», «convertible senior notes due <año>», «term loan», «credit agreement» o «revolving credit»; los resultados dan el número de acceso de la presentación y los documentos que contienen la frase.
